comment: Your own usage limits for tools that can get an account restricted (LinkedIn today). Leave 'servers' empty to use the standard limits. You may LOWER a number freely. To raise one above the standard, add "accept_risk": true next to it and accept that the account could be restricted. Example: { "linkedin": { "categories": { "invite": { "daily_cap": 10, "weekly_cap": 50 }, "profile": { "daily_cap": 20 } } } }. A shorter min_gap_seconds counts as raising. weekday_cap lists the days allowed, for example ["mon", "tue"]. Ask Alterbrain to show the numbers: node system/scripts/rate-guard.mjs status
